{{Quote|I served six years in Tempest Force, rising to sergeant. We were one of the finest legions in the New Order. Saw action at Kashyyyk, Marcelan Prime, Sarko, Aurimaus, and a lot of places you never heard of.|Hume Tarl, excerpt from interview with Cindel Towani included in ''Portraits of the Galactic Civil War''|<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
'''Marcelan Prime''' was a celestial body<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Marcelan Prime system/Legends|same name]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Tempest Force/Legends|Tempest Force]] unit of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|armed forces]], which included<ref name="EGTW" /> the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Sergeant Tarl}}</ref> [[Hume Tarl/Legends|Hume Tarl]], participated in a military operation at Marcelan Prime.<ref name="EGTW" />

When<ref name="EGTW" /> the [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]]<ref name="Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-9-battlfields-of-the-clone-wars|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 9: Battlefields of the Clone Wars}}</ref> [[Cindel Towani]] later interviewed Tarl about the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the latter mentioned the operation at Marcelan Prime as one of the engagements the Tempest Force had been involved in. In [[41 ABY]], Towani included the interview in<ref name="EGTW" /> her<ref name="CSWE Towani">{{CSWECite|III|256|Towani, Cindel}}</ref> work ''[[Portraits of the Galactic Civil War]]''.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''[Tarl has]'' served in battles that are a mix of existing locations and new ones, which ensures the galaxy feels big.|Jason Fry|<ref name="Blog">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/25364458982/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-12|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 12}}</ref>}}
Marcelan Prime was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> In his personal blog, Fry later noted that the locations that were new to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise, such as Marcelan Prime, were introduced in the section of the book containing the interview with Hume Tarl in order to make the ''Star Wars'' [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] seem large.<ref name="Blog" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Marcelan Prime [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Marcelan Prime itself, in grid square J-5.<ref name="EAOC" />
